standard-free-to-play-dialogue.speaker: Guard
standard-free-to-play-dialogue.text: Sorry, you can't come in here.

dig-site-gate-without-153-kudos.npc: Hello there! Sorry, I can't stop to talk. I'm guarding this workman's gate. I'm afraid you can't come through here - you'll need to find another way around.

dig-site-gate-without-153-kudos.text: You need 153 kudos to pass through here.

dig-site-gate-attempting-to-open-the-gat.npc: Hello there! Sorry, I can't stop to talk. I'm guarding this workman's gate. I'm afraid you can't come through here - you'll need to find another way around.

dig-site-gate-attempting-to-open-the-gat.text: You need 153 kudos to pass through here.

dig-site-gate-with-153-kudos.npc: Hello there! Sorry, I can't stop to talk. I'm guarding this workman's gate. As a friend of the museum, you may pass through as you wish.

museum-gate-dialogue-before-completing-t.npc: You're not permitted in this area.

museum-gate-first-dialogue-after-login-w.speaker: Guard
museum-gate-first-dialogue-after-login-w.text: Welcome! Would you like to go into the Dig Site archaeology cleaning area?

steps.text: The player is let into the cleaning finds area.

options.text: No thanks, I'll take a look around out here.

steps.player: No thanks, I'll take a look around out here.

museum-doors-dialogue-before-completing-.npc: Hello there. Come to see the new museum?

museum-doors-dialogue-before-completing-.player: Yes, how do I get in?

museum-doors-dialogue-before-completing-.npc: Well, the main entrance is 'round the front. Just head west then north slightly, you can't miss it!
They're for the workmen bringing finds from the Dig Site; sorry, but you can't go through.

museum-doors-dialogue-before-completing-.speaker: Guard
museum-doors-dialogue-before-completing-.text: Sorry, you can't come in here unless you've completed the Dig Site quest.

museum-doors-dialogue-after-completing-t.npc: Hello there. Come to see the new museum?

museum-doors-dialogue-after-completing-t.player: Yes, how do I get in?

museum-doors-dialogue-after-completing-t.npc: Well, the main entrance is 'round the front. Just head west then north slightly, you can't miss it!
They're primarily for the workmen bringing finds from the Dig Site, but you can go through if you want.

museum-doors-dialogue-after-completing-t.speaker: Guard
museum-doors-dialogue-after-completing-t.text: Hold up there, workman coming through! You'll have to wait a moment; don't want to fall into that wheelbarrow!
